Radio.description: Radio on UI SDK: a group of single-choice options, moved through with the arrow keys, one tab stop for the group.

Group.description: Holds the chosen value and groups the options, in one column, named by its Field.Root label.

value.description: The chosen option's value, when you control it; pair with onValueChange. Use defaultValue otherwise.

defaultValue.description: The option chosen first, when it manages its own state. Unset, none is chosen and Tab enters on the first option.

onValueChange.description: Called with the newly chosen option's value.

disabled.description: Blocks every option, removes them from the tab order and submits nothing.

required.description: A form submit with nothing chosen is blocked and shows Field.Error match="valueMissing". Sets aria-required.

name.description: The name the chosen value is submitted under. Without it the group submits nothing.

Item.description: One option: a ring that holds a dot while it is chosen, with its text as the label, so a press on the text chooses it.

value.description: Names the option; the group's value is the chosen option's value.

disabled.description: Blocks choosing this option and skips it in the arrow keys, and mutes its label.

useWhen: Exactly one of two to five options must be picked, and all of them are worth seeing at once: alert channel, plan.
A choice that takes effect when the form is sent, not the moment it is pressed.

avoidWhen.text: The list is long, or space is tight.
The choice switches a view and shows its content.

a11y: Wrap the group in a Field.Root with a Field.Label that names it; without one, give Radio.Group an aria-label.
Put each option's text in the Radio.Item, as its children: it names the radio and a press on it chooses.
For a required choice, set required and name on Radio.Group, with Field.Error match="valueMissing" beside it.
